entries.cbef5982579e4f45: In the Equipment Division, the company worked on steady execution of projects already received, expanding profitability of painting equipment, expanding sales to non-automotive industries and developing new products, and in the Automotive Parts Division it worked on expanding production of large molded parts, expanding into new areas including other industries, and building a flexible production system strong in high-mix, low-volume production, as printed in the MD&A. Both divisions aim to contribute to customers' achievement of carbon neutrality and a circular economy.
entries.cf70fada0f77fdad: Under its corporate motto 'Trust and Creation', the company positions itself as a comprehensive engineering company for 'heat, water and air', regards its technological capability and manufacturing strength as the source of its competitiveness, and sets as its goal 'toward a future gentle to the earth through technology'. As issues to address, it cites further contribution to a sustainable society, continuous technological innovation and strengthening of the foundation for sustainable growth, and states that it will work toward achieving the medium-term management plan announced in April 2026.

entries.fcb3447c2e4af366: The company positions its technological capability and manufacturing strength as the source of its competitiveness as a comprehensive engineering company for 'heat, water and air'. In the equipment business, in addition to environmental technologies that contribute to CO2 reduction and water resource conservation, the company develops and provides products incorporating digital technologies, such as equipment monitoring systems using IoT and AI and fire prevention solutions, and the filing states that these have earned evaluation from a wide range of customers, including not only automakers but also construction machinery manufacturers. It positions Trinity Technical Solution Center, which opened in October 2025, as a base for creating new value through co-creation with customers and external partners.
